title: Effects of Magnesium Supplementation on Clinical and Biochemical Outcomes in Patients with Chronic Kidney Disease: A Systematic Review of Randomized Controlled Trials
abstractText: Chronic kidney disease (CKD) is associated with metabolic and cardiovascular complications, as well as mineral and bone disorders. Hypomagnesemia occurs in some patients with CKD and has been associated with disease progression and increased mortality. Magnesium supplementation may improve various clinical and biochemical outcomes; however, findings across studies remain inconsistent. A systematic literature search was conducted using electronic databases, including PubMed and Embase, to identify randomized controlled trials (RCTs) evaluating oral magnesium supplementation in adults with CKD. The outcomes assessed included vascular parameters, kidney function, metabolic outcomes, mineral and bone metabolism parameters, inflammatory markers, and safety. Ten RCTs met the eligibility criteria, including seven studies involving patients with nondialysis-dependent CKD and three involving patients undergoing hemodialysis. Intervention durations ranged from 8 weeks to 2 years. Magnesium supplementation demonstrated potential benefits for certain vascular outcomes, particularly carotid intima-media thickness (cIMT) and serum calcification propensity, as measured by the T50 test, as well as selected metabolic parameters. However, its effects on coronary artery calcification (CAC) progression, kidney function, mineral and bone metabolism, inflammation, and oxidative stress were inconsistent across studies. No cases of severe symptomatic hypermagnesemia were reported, although gastrointestinal adverse effects, particularly diarrhea, were among the most frequently reported adverse events. Oral magnesium supplementation may provide benefits for selected vascular and metabolic outcomes in patients with CKD. However, the available evidence remains inconsistent and insufficient to support routine magnesium supplementation in all patients with CKD.

title: Chuyển đổi số trong doanh nghiệp du lịch vừa và nhỏ: tổng quan hệ thống và đề xuất khung lý thuyết tích hợp
abstractText: Chuyển đổi số là xu hướng tất yếu đối với doanh nghiệp du lịch vừa và nhỏ trong bối cảnh cạnh tranh gia tăng sau đại dịch COVID-19. Bài báo tổng quan hệ thống theo quy trình PRISMA 86 nghiên cứu trong nước và quốc tế, chọn lọc từ 379 bản ghi, nhằm hệ thống hóa cơ sở lý thuyết và nhận diện động lực, rào cản, kết quả chuyển đổi số. Trên nền tảng lý thuyết năng lực động, đổi mới mô hình kinh doanh và sức bền tổ chức, nghiên cứu đề xuất khung lý thuyết tích hợp gồm bốn thành phần: bối cảnh và động lực; năng lực số và nguồn lực nội tại; triển khai theo chiều sâu công nghệ; kết quả đa chiều. Ba điểm mới của khung, gồm vai trò điều tiết của năng lực số, ngưỡng năng lực gắn với từng tầng công nghệ và vòng phản hồi từ kết quả về bối cảnh, được cụ thể hóa thành tám mệnh đề có thể kiểm chứng. Bài báo cũng phân tích bảy điều kiện vận dụng khung tại Việt Nam và đề xuất hàm ý cho doanh nghiệp, cơ quan quản lý.

title: Written Argumentation Profiles of Slow Learners and Regular Students on Lavoisier’s Law Using UDL-Based SHCRT Student Activity Sheets
abstractText: This study examined the written argumentation profiles of typical students and students with learning difficulties through the implementation of Study Activity Sheets (LAPD) based on Scaffolding Handwritten Response Tasks (SHCRT) within the Universal Design for Learning (UDL) model on the topic of Lavoisier’s Law. Using a qualitative descriptive design, this study involved four participants: two typical students and two students with learning difficulties. Data were collected through a pretest, LAPD, posttest, interviews, observations, and student response questionnaires, and analyzed using NVivo 12 (project map and matrix coding query) to describe the quality of arguments based on the components of claims, evidence, and reasoning. The findings indicate an increase in students’ conceptual understanding following the implementation of SHCRT-based LAPD, accompanied by more comprehensive arguments from the pretest to the posttest; however, students with learning difficulties tended to produce brief and less coherent arguments and required more scaffolding guidance than regular students. These findings indicate that SHCRT-based LAPD, using the UDL model, can serve as a learning medium that supports students’ scientific reasoning and conceptual understanding, as well as a model for developing chemistry instructional materials tailored to students’ diverse needs. The novelty of this research lies in the integration of scaffolding strategies, multiple representations, and writing-to-learn strategies into the LAPD instrument, which was analyzed using NVivo to illustrate differences in the quality of arguments between regular students and students with learning difficulties.

title: 0.01% atropine eye drops and axial elongation in pre-myopic children: a real-world study
abstractText: Abstract Purpose This study aimed to evaluate the association between 0.01% atropine use and axial length (AL) elongation, as well as refractive change, in pre-myopic children using real-world clinical data. Methods In this retrospective analysis, pre-myopic children aged 6–12 years (by non-cycloplegic subjective refraction) were included. After 1:2 propensity score matching (PSM), 176 children treated with nightly 0.01% atropine were compared with 352 untreated controls ( N = 528). All participants had approximately 6 months of follow-up (mean 7–8 months). The primary outcomes were the rates of change in AL and SE, assessed with linear mixed-effects models; myopia incidence (SE ≤ − 0.50 D) was assessed as a secondary outcome using an interval-censored Cox model. A subgroup analysis by baseline AL progression rate (fast: ≥0.08 mm per 3 months vs. slow: <0.08 mm per 3 months) was prespecified as exploratory and was not adjusted for multiple comparisons; effect modification by corneal curvature was assessed with a treatment × time × flat keratometry interaction model. Results The intervention group showed significantly slower AL elongation (between-group difference − 0.021 mm per 3 months, 95% CI − 0.033 to − 0.010, P < 0.001), whereas the difference in SE progression was not statistically significant ( P = 0.069). Myopia incidence did not differ significantly between groups (38.1% vs. 42.6%; hazard ratio 0.89, 95% CI 0.66 to 1.20, P = 0.44). In an exploratory subgroup analysis, the effect appeared larger in the fast-progression subgroup; however, the treatment × time × flat keratometry interaction was not significant for AL ( P = 0.109). Conclusions Use of 0.01% atropine was associated with modestly slower axial elongation in pre-myopic children. An exploratory subgroup analysis suggested a possibly greater effect in children with rapid baseline axial elongation, but these findings require prospective confirmation. On-chip multimode vibrational strong coupling of polar dielectrics within hybrid metal–dielectric nanocavities
abstractText: Abstract Vibrational strong coupling (VSC) provides a powerful route to manipulate energy exchange and polaritonic energy landscapes through the hybridization of vibrational modes with optical resonances, offering significant potential for ultrasensitive infrared spectroscopy, biochemical sensing, and the control of chemical reactivity. Plasmonic nanocavities can achieve strong confinement, but their substantial ohmic losses often broaden the optical resonance and obscure the intrinsic evolution of hybrid branches. In contrast, low-loss dielectric platforms generally suffer from insufficient field overlap with the vibrational medium. Moreover, in dual-channel or mode-selective architectures, coupling behavior is highly sensitive to localized hotspots and the precise placement of the active layer. Consequently, achieving simultaneous and robust access to both transverse-optical (TO) and longitudinal-optical (LO) channels remains challenging, especially within systems that require continuous tunability and fabrication simplicity. Here, we experimentally demonstrate multimode VSC in a hybrid metal–dielectric nanocavity, where the optical field is strongly confined inside the SiO 2 layer. Owing to the coexistence of in-plane and out-of-plane electric field components in the vibrational layer, the same photonic mode can simultaneously couple to both the TO and LO phonon responses of SiO 2 . The measured Fourier transform infrared spectra agree well with full-wave simulations and are quantitatively reproduced by an effective three-oscillator model. By varying the thickness of SiO 2 , we further reveal the relationship between the coupling strength, the polar molecular layer thickness, and the effective mode volume. The proposed architecture also shows good robustness against the fabrication distortions, establishing a low-loss and experimentally feasible platform for multimode VSC in polar dielectrics.

title: Long-term biocompatibility and efficacy of DNA supramolecular hydrogels as vitreous substitutes in a rabbit model of retinal detachment
abstractText: Abstract Purpose Retinal detachment (RD) is an ophthalmic emergency requiring prompt surgical repair and intraocular tamponade. Current vitreous substitutes such as silicone oil, although effective, often lead to complications. DNA supramolecular hydrogels have emerged as promising alternatives owing to their biocompatibility and transparency, yet their clinical use has been hindered by issues in degradation control and injectability. We aimed to study explore the potential of a DNA supramolecular hydrogel as a superior vitreous substitute. Methods We developed a DNA supramolecular hydrogel mimicking key physicochemical properties of the natural vitreous. Using a rabbit RD model, we assessed retinal reattachment rate, intraocular pressure, and cytotoxicity, with silicone oil as control. Enhanced computed tomography (CT) imaging was used to evaluate hydrogel permeability. Results In the rabbit RD model, the DNA hydrogel effectively promoted retinal reattachment over a 6-month monitoring period, achieving outcomes comparable to silicone oil. CT imaging confirmed high permeability of the hydrogel. Its superior permeability may help reduce complications associated with conventional tamponade agents. Conclusion DNA supramolecular hydrogels represent a durable and permeable vitreous substitute that effectively reattaches retina and supports metabolic exchange, offering a promising strategy for advancing vitreous replacement therapy.

title: HUBUNGAN INDEKS MASA TUBUH DENGAN KADAR GULA DARAH SEWAKTU PADA MASYARAKAT KELURAHAN WALIAN DUA, TOMOHON
abstractText: Excessive body mass index (BMI) and elevated blood glucose levels are important factors to consider in the prevention of type 2 diabetes mellitus. This study aimed to analyze the relationship between BMI and random blood glucose levels among residents of Walian Dua Village, Tomohon City. A descriptive correlational study with a cross-sectional approach was conducted. The sample consisted of 122 respondents aged 40 years and older, selected using purposive sampling. BMI was determined by measuring body weight and height, while random blood glucose levels were measured using an Auto-Check 3 in 1 glucometer. Data were analyzed using univariate and bivariate analyses, with Spearman’s rank correlation applied because the data were not normally distributed. The results showed that most respondents were classified as Obesity Class I (51 respondents, 41.8%), followed by Obesity Class II (29 respondents, 23.8%) and overweight with increased risk (16 respondents, 13.1%). Overall, the majority of respondents were classified as overweight or obese. Regarding random blood glucose levels, the most common category was prediabetes (61 respondents, 50.0%), followed by normoglycemia (32 respondents, 26.2%) and hyperglycemia (29 respondents, 23.8%), according to the study’s classification. Correlation analysis revealed no statistically significant relationship between BMI and random blood glucose levels (p = 0.136). It is recommended that individuals who are overweight or obese and those with elevated blood glucose levels undergo further glycemic assessment, particularly glycated hemoglobin (HbA1c) testing, to evaluate average blood glucose levels over the preceding two to three months.

title: Examining udder and teat traits in Australian Merino ewes: genetic variance recorded within and across lactations
abstractText: Context Reducing neonatal lamb mortality remains a major challenge globally, and early survival is strongly influenced by the ewe’s ability to provide adequate colostrum and milk. Udder and teat traits have been shown to affect lamb growth and survival; however, their genetic parameters are not well defined in Australian Merinos, particularly regarding how these traits change within a lactation and over the ewe’s lifetime. Aims This study aimed to estimate preliminary genetic parameters for four visually scored traits, udder depth, udder cleft, teat size and teat placement, recorded at lambing and weaning within a single lactation, as well as across age classes. Methods A total of 1257 ewes were scored at both lambing and weaning, and longitudinal records were collected from 2 to 6 years of age to assess the stability of the traits across lactations. Key results Heritability estimates were low to moderate (0.11 ± 0.04 to 0.42 ± 0.09) both within lactation and across age stages, indicating these traits have potential to be improved through selection. Genetic correlations between records taken at lambing and weaning were moderate to high (0.59–0.95), suggesting that most traits are consistently expressed throughout the lactation. Similarly, high genetic correlations (≥0.90) across age classes indicate that udder and teat traits are genetically stable across the ewe’s productive life, perhaps except for teat size, which showed lower correlations between early and later life measurements (0.70). Conclusions Together, these findings imply that a single recording at either lambing or weaning may be sufficient to capture an animal’s genetic merit for udder depth and teat placement. However, repeatability across age stages was low to moderate (0.21–0.29), suggesting that multiple assessments over successive lactations may still improve the accuracy of selection, particularly for teat size, which showed greater variability in genetic expression with age. Implications The estimates within this study provide sound foundational knowledge for how genetic variation in udder and teat traits changes over time in Merino sheep, which have been selected for wool and meat production rather than milking ability.

A data-based approach for predicting hardness in friction stir additive manufacturing of EN AW-7075-T6
abstractText: Abstract Friction stir additive manufacturing (FSAM) is an emerging additive manufacturing process for fabricating large aerospace components made from aluminum alloys (e.g., EN AW-7075-T6). In the studies presented in this article, the hardness losses typical for this process were addressed. The objective of the investigations was to model these hardness losses using non-numerical methods, thereby increasing their applicability to industry. It was demonstrated that the hardness of the topmost layer was similar across parts with different numbers of layers due to the application of a temperature control system. A time-temperature metric (called cumulated hold time) was defined to predict the mean hardness of the underlying reheated layers (correlation coefficient of − 0.951). Using the lumped capacitance method, the cumulated hold time was modeled from the energy per length during welding. The developed submodels enable prediction of hardness profiles with an RMSE of 2.3 HV 0.2 and identification of suitable process parameters without measuring the part’s temperatures during fabrication. Experimental investigations showed that the welding temperature had a small positive effect on the hardness of the top layers and a negative one on the bottom layers; however, the positive effect of the welding speed on the hardness of all layers was dominant.

title: Ẩn dụ cách thức trong nghĩa chuyển của từ Hán Việt trên báo chí tiếng Việt
abstractText: Từ vựng là bộ phận biến động mạnh mẽ nhất của ngôn ngữ, phản ánh sự vận động và phát triển của xã hội. Dựa trên lý thuyết về hệ thống từ vựng ngữ nghĩa và sự chuyển nghĩa của Đỗ Hữu Châu và Nguyễn Thiện Giáp, bài báo tập trung nghiên cứu sự chuyển nghĩa của từ Hán Việt trong báo chí tiếng Việt (từ năm 2000 đến năm 2026) theo cơ chế ẩn dụ, từ đó khẳng định rằng ẩn dụ không chỉ là biện pháp tu từ mà còn là cơ chế chuyển nghĩa quan trọng của từ. Qua khảo sát 2000 kiểu từ Hán Việt, nghiên cứu xác lập được 54 kiểu từ Hán Việt chuyển nghĩa theo cơ chế ẩn dụ cách thức với 102 lượt xuất hiện được phân chia thành 6 tiểu nhóm chính: ẩn dụ cách thức tác động, ẩn dụ cách thức dịch chuyển, ẩn dụ cách thức thu nạp và chuyển hóa, ẩn dụ cách thức bộc lộ, ẩn dụ cấu trúc hóa (gom/tách) nguồn lực, ẩn dụ cách thức điều phối.

title: AI in higher education: navigating practical benefits and perceived risks from students' perspectives
abstractText: This quantitative study surveyed 435 university students using a 5-point Likert scale to analyze artificial intelligence (AI) adoption. Grounded in an extended Technology Acceptance Model, the research examines perceived usefulness, control ability, perceived risk, intention to use, and learning impact. Results indicate that perceived usefulness is the strongest predictor of intention to use AI (β = 0.498; p < 0.001), followed by the ability to control and use AI responsibly (β = 0.153; p < 0.001). Conversely, perceived risk has a negative effect (β = −0.189; p < 0.001). Notably, the intention to use AI positively influences learning impact (β = 0.347; p < 0.001) and serves as a partial mediator. The model explains 44.5% of the variance in learning impact. Findings suggest that integrating AI into higher education requires clear pedagogical guidance to maximize benefits while mitigating potential risks.

EFETIVIDADE DO LASER DE CO2 FRACIONADO NO TRATAMENTO DE CICATRIZES DE QUEIMADURAS: UMA REVISÃO SISTEMÁTICA
abstractText: Introdução: As queimaduras resultam em formações cicatriciais que geram repercussões funcionais e estéticas. O laser de CO₂ fracionado atua estimulando o resurfacing e a renovação do colágeno na derme. Objetivo: Analisar a efetividade do laser de CO₂ fracionado na textura, na espessura e na pigmentação de cicatrizes de queimadura. Metodologia: Trata-se de uma revisão sistemática guiada pelo modelo PRISMA e registrada na PROSPERO. A busca foi realizada nas bases PubMed, CENTRAL e PEDro. Foram selecionados ensaios clínicos randomizados (ECRs) avaliados pelas ferramentas RoB 2 e escala PEDro. Resultados: A análise de 4 ECRs demonstrou que o laser de CO₂ fracionado isolado é efetivo na redução da espessura e na melhora da textura das cicatrizes. Para a alteração de pigmentação, os melhores resultados ocorreram quando o laser foi associado a medicamentos tópicos. Os efeitos colaterais foram leves e de fácil manejo. Os estudos apresentaram algumas preocupações quanto ao risco de viés devido à inviabilidade do cegamento da aplicação. Conclusão: O laser de CO₂ fracionado isolado é seguro e eficaz para a textura e espessura da cicatriz, sendo necessária a associação medicamentosa para a pigmentação. Sugere-se a realização de novos ensaios clínicos com amostras maiores para definir diretrizes de dosimetria.

title: Enhanced output voltage regulation in a seven-level inverter with minimal active power switches for renewable energy applications
abstractText: Smart inverters are a prevalent solution in renewable energy applications due to their capacity to provide output voltage with minimal harmonic distortion and ease of control and operation. This trend has driven the rapid growth of power converters in various renewable energy applications. This research aims to design a strategy and implementation technique for a single-phase seven-level (SPSL) inverter that can control output voltage accurately. This research is innovative because it constructs an SPSL inverter with six active power switches and a new control strategy. This inverter comprises two active power switches that operate as a three-level direct current (DC) voltage shaper and four active power switches for polarity inversion. This inverter is controlled using advanced sinusoidal pulse width modulation (SPWM) methods. The inverter SPSL was selected because it can produce smoother sine waves with a total harmonic distortion (THD) less than the IEEE standard. The SPSL inverter's power circuit is controlled by a microcontroller-based control system, which enables the inverter to dynamically adapt to changes in load and operating conditions. This study performed simulations and verified the design performance via hardware implementation. The results from the simulations and lab tests indicate that the inverter works well with a THD of 4.16%; the SPSL inverter created in this study is a suitable option for improving inverter applications in renewable energy systems.

title: Evidence synthesis and decision governance for artificial intelligence in sustainable gold mining in the Ecuadorian Amazon
abstractText: Abstract Artificial intelligence is increasingly used across mining, but its contribution to sustainable gold production remains uncertain. This integrative review evaluates where AI evidence is mature, how it is validated, and what it implies for Ecuador and the Chupianza concession. The revised auditable corpus comprised 42 scientific and technical sources published from 2014 to September 2026 and coded by lifecycle stage, region, method, validation, sustainability dimension and evidence level. Monitoring and environmental-context studies were most frequent ( n = 17), followed by exploration and resources ( n = 11), processing and recovery ( n = 8), and planning, operations and safety ( n = 6). Eighteen sources evaluated specific AI models, but none prospectively demonstrated improvement in operational decisions or measured sustainability outcomes. Ecuadorian evidence mainly documents mercury exposure, land degradation, restoration needs and remotely observed mining-associated change. A four-layer evidence-to-decision framework is proposed to connect local data, models, accountable decisions and economic, environmental, safety and social outcomes. Chupianza is a prospective test setting rather than a demonstrated AI application; geological characterization, baseline indicators, spatial and temporal validation, uncertainty controls and human oversight are required before deployment claims can be made.

title: 2C-LEARNING: INTEGRASI PEMBELAJARAN KREATIF DAN SOSIAL-EMOSIONAL DALAM MENGATASI PERUNDUNGAN ANAK
abstractText: ABSTRACT Bullying among children highlights the importance of strengthening social-emotional competencies from an early age, particularly in recognizing bullying behavior, managing emotions, and developing positive relationships with peers. This community service program aimed to strengthen the social-emotional competencies of 15 children exhibiting bullying-related behaviors in Kampung Pelangi, Surabaya, through the Wandersea program, which integrates creative learning and social-emotional learning (SEL) based on the local wisdom values of Trisilas: silih asah (mutual learning), silih asih (mutual caring), and silih asuh (mutual guidance). Wandersea was implemented in collaboration with the Komunitas Pelajar Mengajar Surabaya using the 2C-Learning approach as its learning framework through six activities, including storytelling, role-playing, traditional games, crafts made from seashell waste, and parenting education for parents. Evaluation was conducted descriptively through in-depth interviews at the initial stage, an end-of-program reflection on the Wanderland game using 11 assessment items, and the Sea Hero Card. Analysis of four comparable items between the initial and final assessments using the exact McNemar test indicated an increase of 40.0–80.0 percentage points in expected responses. At the end of the program, all children were able to explain the meaning of bullying and no longer identified teasing and hitting as forms of joking or ways to intimidate others, while 12 children were able to identify ways to calm themselves when angry. In addition, 12 children were observed demonstrating the ability to establish positive relationships with their peers. These findings indicate positive changes in children's understanding and social-emotional responses during the program; however, they do not establish complete behavioral changes or demonstrate a causal effect of the intervention. The program also produced a handbook and curriculum adopted by the partner organization. Overall, Wandersea represents a promising community-based approach to strengthening children's social-emotional competencies through local wisdom, which may be adapted to other communities with similar challenges. ABSTRAK Perundungan antaranak menunjukkan pentingnya penguatan kompetensi sosial-emosional sejak dini, khususnya dalam mengenali perilaku perundungan, mengelola emosi, dan membangun hubungan positif dengan teman sebaya. Kegiatan pengabdian kepada masyarakat ini bertujuan memperkuat kompetensi sosial-emosional 15 anak yang teridentifikasi menunjukkan perilaku perundungan di Kampung Pelangi, Surabaya, melalui program Wandersea dengan pendekatan 2C-Learning (Creative Learning dan Social-Emotional Learning/SEL) yang diintegrasikan dengan nilai kearifan lokal Trisilas, yaitu silih asah, silih asih, dan silih asuh. Program dilaksanakan bersama Komunitas Pelajar Mengajar Surabaya melalui enam kegiatan yang mencakup dongeng, bermain peran, permainan tradisional, pembuatan kerajinan dari limbah kerang, dan edukasi pengasuhan bagi orang tua. Evaluasi dilakukan secara deskriptif melalui wawancara mendalam pada kondisi awal, refleksi akhir permainan Wanderland menggunakan 11 butir penilaian, dan Sea Hero Card. Analisis terhadap empat butir yang sepadan antara kondisi awal dan akhir menggunakan uji McNemar eksak menunjukkan peningkatan proporsi respons yang diharapkan sebesar 40,0–80,0 poin persentase. Pada akhir program, seluruh anak mampu menjelaskan arti perundungan dan tidak lagi mengidentifikasi ejekan maupun pukulan sebagai candaan atau cara untuk ditakuti, sedangkan 12 anak mampu menyebutkan cara menenangkan diri ketika marah. Selain itu, 12 anak teramati menunjukkan kemampuan membangun hubungan positif dengan teman. Program ini juga menghasilkan buku pedoman dan kurikulum yang diadopsi oleh mitra. Temuan tersebut mengindikasikan adanya perubahan pemahaman dan respons sosial-emosional anak selama pelaksanaan program, tetapi belum dapat digunakan untuk menyimpulkan perubahan perilaku perundungan secara menyeluruh maupun efektivitas kausal program. Dengan demikian, Wandersea berpotensi menjadi model penguatan kompetensi sosial-emosional berbasis 2C-Learning dan kearifan lokal yang dapat dikembangkan pada komunitas lain dengan permasalahan serupa.

Segment feature classification method for hepatocellular carcinoma detection from CT images
abstractText: Abstract Hepatocellular Carcinoma (HCC) is a chronic liver cancer triggered by hepatitis B or C identified by abdominal pain and jaundice. Computed Tomography (CT) images are used to analyze the type of HCC as primary or solitary based on the infected ratio. This detection and classification utilize machine learning and correlation datasets for precise diagnosis outcomes. In this article, a Segment Feature Classification Method using Region Normalization (SFCM-RN) is introduced. The proposed method identifies heterogeneity measures between the extracted features under two differentiations: the normal and infected regions. The segmentation process is pursued based on null or fewer heterogeneity measures. The differentiations per region are normalized to identify the infection ratio that increases the classifications. Hence this differentiation to normalization case is iteratively verified using sectional deep learning where the single connected layer performs both normalization to differentiation and vice-versa. The iteration is halted if the maximum infected rate is identified through training inputs. The proposed method improves accuracy, F1-score, recall, and precision by 15.52%, 12.51%, 11.24%, and 11.98% respectively. The proposed method reduces error by 14.51% for the maximum feature set.

title: Clinical Characteristics and Potentially Harmful Behaviors in Patients with Delirium After Cardiac Surgery
abstractText: Objective: To describe selected clinical characteristics and behavioral manifestations associated with risks of harm to patients and healthcare workers among patients with delirium after cardiac surgery. Subjects and Methods: A prospective descriptive study was conducted in adult patients aged ≥18 years who underwent cardiac surgery and were treated in the Postoperative Cardiac Intensive Care Unit from June to December 2025. Sedation and level of consciousness were assessed using the Richmond Agitation-Sedation Scale (RASS), and delirium was screened using the Confusion Assessment Method for the Intensive Care Unit (CAM-ICU). Patients with RASS scores of −4 or −5 were reassessed when their level of consciousness permitted evaluation. Postoperative delirium was identified by acute onset or fluctuating course, inattention, and either disorganized thinking or altered level of consciousness. Potentially dangerous behaviors toward patients and healthcare workers were recorded during follow-up. Results: A total of 38 patients with postoperative delirium after cardiac surgery were included. The mean age was 60.35 ± 10.84 years, and 73.7% were female. The mean time to onset of postoperative delirium was 25.47 ± 26.76 hours after admission to the intensive care unit; 36.8% of cases occurred on postoperative day 0 and 47.4% on postoperative day 1. The condition lasted 1 day in 60.5% of patients and 2 days in 26.3%. Hyperactive delirium was the predominant clinical subtype, with no mixed subtype identified. With 36.84% patients had prolonging the duration of mechanical ventilation beyond the initial plan due to postoperative delirium. The most common potentially harmful behaviors toward patients were self-removal of intravenous lines (21.1%), removal of nasogastric tubes (13.2%), striking the head or limbs (13.2%), removal of urinary catheters (10.5%), and self-extubation (5.3%). Behaviors posing risks to healthcare workers and caregivers included verbal abuse or insults (57.9%), spitting (39.5%), scratching, pinching, or biting (26.3%), and hitting or kicking (15.8%). Haloperidol was administered to 92.1% of patients, while physical restraint was used in 94.7%. Conclusion: Postoperative delirium occurred predominantly within the first 24–48 hours and was mainly characterized by hyperactive manifestations. It was associated with substantial risks to both patients and healthcare workers, particularly through self-removal of therapeutic devices, agitation, and aggressive behaviors. It is important for ensuring patient and healthcare-worker safety in the postoperative cardiac intensive care setting.

title: Physiological functions of fructooligosaccharides and its application progress in food
abstractText: Abstract Fructooligosaccharides (FOS) are naturally sourced, low-calorie carbohydrates that resist human digestive enzymes in the gastrointestinal tract. They are selectively fermented by certain Lactobacillus and Bifidobacterium species in the colon, thereby producing short-chain fatty acids (SCFAs). This process promotes the growth of beneficial microbiota while inhibiting pathogenic microorganisms. Consequently, they are classified as prebiotics. By interacting with the gut microbiota, FOS elicit various physiological effects and have attracted considerable research attention in functional food studies due to their favorable physicochemical and biological properties. This review systematically summarizes and critically evaluates recent advances on the physiological functions of FOS, covering their roles in maintaining intestinal microbial balance, reducing plasma levels of cholesterol, phospholipids, and triglycerides, regulating blood glucose levels, and enhancing immunity. Their potential involvement in tumour inhibition and mineral absorption is also discussed. Furthermore, this review examines recent progress in the application of FOS in food systems, including baked goods, meat products, dairy and non-dairy beverages, and animal feed. Special emphasis is placed on emerging in-situ enzymatic conversion technologies, which could enable more flexible and cost-effective utilization of FOS. Additionally, current common biosynthetic strategies are also outlined. Overall, this review highlights the key challenges and future prospects of FOS in functional foods, and provides critical insights for its application in personalized nutrition and disease management.

title: Knowledge and adherence to oral anticoagulant therapy among patients with non-valvular atrial fibrillation at Hanoi Heart Hospital in 2025
abstractText: Objective: Non-valvular atrial fibrillation (NVAF) is a major risk factor for embolic stroke, necessitating lifelong oral anticoagulation (OAC) therapy. The effectiveness of OAC in clinical practice is heavily dependent on patient adherence and knowledge. This study aimed to describe the current status of knowledge and practice regarding OAC therapy and to identify factors associated with treatment adherence among NVAF outpatients at the Voluntary Outpatient Department of Hanoi Heart Hospital). Methods: A descriptive cross-sectional study was conducted on 100 NVAF outpatients from May 2025 to December 2025. Data were collected through face-to-face interviews using a structured questionnaire. Knowledge was assessed using the Oral Anticoagulation Knowledge Tool (AKT) by Obamiro, where a score of ≥60% was considered "adequate". Treatment adherence was measured using the 8-item Morisky Medication Adherence Scale (MMAS-8), classified into high (8 points), medium (6-7 points), and low (<6 points) adherence levels. Statistical analysis was performed using SPSS 20.0, utilizing Fisher’s Exact Test and univariate logistic regression to calculate Odds Ratios (OR) with a 95% confidence interval (CI). Results: The mean age of the participants was 63.4 ± 10.1 years, with 57% being male. Most patients had co-morbidities, including hypertension (51%), heart failure (46%), and coronary artery disease (41%). Regarding knowledge, 78% of participants were classified as having "inadequate knowledge". Specifically, 84% could not correctly identify the name of their anticoagulant, 98% believed they could stop the medication when feeling well, and 72% were unaware that missing a dose could worsen their condition. In terms of adherence, only 25% achieved high adherence, while 53% showed medium adherence and 22% showed low adherence. Common barriers included forgetting medication while traveling (49%) and general difficulty in remembering the daily regimen (39%). Associated factors for adequate knowledge included having a reminder for medication (OR=5.64, 95%CI: 1.71-18.56, p<0.01). Factors significantly associated with better adherence included clear counseling from healthcare providers (OR=4.33, 95%CI: 1.60-11.69, p<0.01), having a medication reminder (OR=3.07, 95%CI: 1.05-8.95, p=0.04), and possessing adequate treatment knowledge (OR=3.50, 95%CI: 1.27-9.62, p=0.02). Conclusion: Knowledge and adherence regarding oral anticoagulation therapy among NVAF patients at Hanoi Heart Hospital are considerably limited. The study highlights that clinical outcomes can be significantly improved through effective medical counseling, family support systems (reminders), and targeted health education. These findings underscore the necessity for personalized patient management strategies and continuous educational interventions to optimize stroke prevention in AF populations.

title: Formula Sediaan Tablet Hisap Ekstrak Daun Sirih (Piper betle L.) Menggunakan Metode Granulasi Basah dengan Variasi Konsentrasi Pengikat Gelatin
abstractText: Daun sirih Piper betle L. memiliki potensi sebagai bahan aktif sediaan perawatan rongga mulut, tetapi pengembangannya menjadi tablet hisap memerlukan pemilihan konsentrasi pengikat yang sesuai. Penelitian ini bertujuan mengevaluasi karakteristik fisik tablet hisap ekstrak daun sirih yang dibuat menggunakan metode granulasi basah dengan variasi konsentrasi gelatin. Penelitian dilakukan secara eksperimental melalui pembuatan tiga formula dengan konsentrasi gelatin 3%, 5%, dan 7%, serta bobot nominal tablet 700 mg. Evaluasi meliputi skrining fitokimia, susut pengeringan, sifat alir, sudut diam, kompresibilitas granul, keseragaman bobot, kekerasan, kerapuhan, dan waktu larut tablet. Hasil skrining menunjukkan keberadaan tanin dan flavonoid. Susut pengeringan granul masing-masing sebesar 4,76%, 3,85%, dan 4,63%, sedangkan kompresibilitasnya sebesar 15,5343%, 15,8419%, dan 15,5329%. Rerata bobot tablet berturut-turut sebesar 0,6823; 0,6863; dan 0,6860 gram. Ketiga formula memenuhi persyaratan keseragaman bobot dan memiliki kerapuhan kurang dari 1%. Nilai kekerasan meningkat dari 5,45 menjadi 11,10 dan 12,01 seiring peningkatan konsentrasi gelatin. Peningkatan tersebut mengindikasikan penguatan ikatan antarpartikel dan disertai kecenderungan pemanjangan waktu larut. Disimpulkan bahwa gelatin memengaruhi karakteristik fisik tablet hisap ekstrak daun sirih, terutama kekerasan dan waktu larut. Penetapan formula terbaik memerlukan penyelarasan kriteria evaluasi serta verifikasi hasil waktu larut. Penelitian lanjutan diperlukan untuk mengevaluasi stabilitas, keamanan, dan aktivitas antimikroba sediaan jadi sebelum pengembangan klinis.

title: Piperidine Molecular Engineering in Polyaromatic Membranes for High-Performance High Temperature Proton Exchange Membrane Fuel Cells
abstractText: Abstract High temperature proton exchange membrane fuel cells (HT-PEMFCs) require polymer electrolytes that simultaneously achieve efficient proton transport, excellent chemical durability, and mechanical stability under harsh operating conditions. Poly(terphenyl piperidine) (PTP) based membranes have emerged as promising candidates owing to their rigid aromatic backbones and strong acid-base interactions with phosphoric acid (PA); however, the influence of piperidine molecular structures on membrane properties remains largely unexplored and limited chemical stability need to be solved. Herein, we report a molecular engineering strategy that regulates the intrinsic piperidine configuration in PTP polymers to establish the relationship between piperidine structure, PA interaction, and membrane performance. Five structurally different piperidone monomers, including N-methyl-4-piperidone, 4-piperidone hydrochloride monohydrate, piperidine-3-one hydrochloride, N-propyl-4-piperidone, and N-benzyl-4-piperidone, are employed to polymerize with terphenyl through superacid-catalyzed Friedel–Crafts polymerization to obtain PTP, PTP-4-H, PTP-3-H, PTPP, and PTBP, respectively. The results reveal that N-substituents on the piperidine ring strongly affect polymer chain packing, PA affinity, oxidative stability, and mechanical properties. Among the investigated polymers, PTP-4-H with unsubstituted piperidine units exhibits the optimal balance between chemical stability, proton conductivity and mechanical robustness. Furthermore, biphenyl units are introduced into the PTP-4-H backbone to increase the density of piperidine functional groups and construct more efficient proton-conducting networks. The optimized P(TP70%-BP30%–4-H)/PA membrane achieves a high proton conductivity of 83 mS cm–1 at 180 °C and maintained a tensile strength of 8.0 MPa after PA doping. When assembled into an H2/O2 single cell without external humidification or back pressure, the membrane delivers a peak power density of 1039 mW cm–2 at 180 °C. This work provides insights into the molecular-level regulation of piperidine-containing aromatic polymers and demonstrates that rational control of piperidine configuration and density is an effective strategy for developing high-performance HT-PEMs.

title: Characteristics of prediabetes, newly detected type 2 diabetes mellitus and associated factors among outpatients at Hanoi Heart Hospital
abstractText: Objective: To describe the characteristics of patients with prediabetes and newly detected type 2 diabetes mellitus, and to identify factors associated with newly detected type 2 diabetes (versus prediabetes) among outpatients at Hanoi Heart Hospital. Methods: A cross-sectional study with an analytical component was conducted among 92 cardiovascular outpatients with prediabetes or newly detected type 2 diabetes at Hanoi Heart Hospital from May 2025 to July 2026. Associated factors were examined using univariable and multivariable logistic regression. Results: Thirty-five patients (38.0%) had prediabetes and 57 (62.0%) had newly detected type 2 diabetes. The mean age was 63.97 ± 11.78 years, and 62.0% were male. HbA1c and random glucose levels were significantly higher in patients with newly detected diabetes. In the multivariable model (n=88), eGFR <60 mL/min/1.73 m² (aOR=0.20; 95% CI: 0.05–0.84) and calcium channel blocker (CCB) use for less than one year (aOR=0.07; 95% CI: 0.01–0.71; only 7 patients) were inversely associated with newly detected diabetes. HDL-C <0.9 mmol/L showed a positive but non-significant trend (aOR=7.80; 95% CI: 0.86–70.69; p=0.068). Conclusion: Among cardiovascular outpatients with dysglycemia, low HDL-C (as a trend), eGFR <60 mL/min/1.73 m² and CCB use for less than one year were associated with newly detected type 2 diabetes. These associations do not establish causality and should be confirmed in larger longitudinal studies. The findings support systematic glucose/HbA1c screening in at-risk cardiovascular patients.

title: ANALISIS PENGELOMPOKAN OBAT BERDASARKAN METODE ABC-VEN TERHADAP DATA PENJUALAN DI APOTEK X PERIODE TAHUN 2024
abstractText: Efficient and rational pharmaceutical management is essential for ensuring the quality of pharmacy services. However, procurement based on estimation rather than structured analysis carries the risk of resulting in either excess stock or shortages. This study aims to analyze the classification of medications using the ABC–VEN method, based on sales data from Pharmacy X in 2024. A quantitative descriptive design with a retrospective approach was employed, utilizing sales reports from January to December 2024 through a total sampling technique. The results indicate that for non-oral preparations (43 items; IDR 8,742,090), liquid oral preparations (78 items; IDR 24,013,815), and solid oral preparations (163 items; IDR 54,172,572), the "AE" category—representing items classified as both high-value (A) and vital (E)—falls under "Priority I." This category accounts for the highest share of investment value—52.94%, 36.89%, and 49.70%, respectively—making it the primary focus for inventory control to ensure both efficiency and the consistent availability of medications.

title: Effect of calcium carbonate on the thermodynamics and kinetics of lead sulfide carbothermic reduction
abstractText: Abstract The effect of calcium carbonate on the thermodynamics and apparent kinetics of lead sulfide (PbS) carbothermic reduction was investigated in the PbS–Na 2 CO 3 –C and PbS–Na 2 CO 3 –CaCO 3 –C systems at 800–1100 °C. Thermodynamic analysis included Gibbs free energy calculations and multiphase equilibrium modeling, while kinetic behavior was evaluated through time-resolved gas analysis and TG–DTG–DSC measurements. Equilibrium calculations revealed predominant Na 2 S formation in the CaCO 3 -free system and CaS formation in the CaCO 3 -containing system. At 800 °C, the calculated equilibrium amount of metallic lead increased from 804.29 to 999.83 mol upon CaCO 3 addition, based on 1000 mol of initial PbS. Sodium carbonate remained largely unconsumed in the CaCO 3 -containing system. Experimental results demonstrated a pronounced temperature-dependent effect of CaCO 3 . At 800 °C, the apparent reaction extent (α app ) was 70.6% with CaCO 3 and 74.9% without it. At 900, 1000, and 1100 °C, α app reached 96.4%, 97.9%, and 99.5%, respectively, in the CaCO 3 -containing system, accompanied by higher apparent reaction rates. The corresponding apparent activation energies were 32.0 and 52.9 kJ·mol − 1 , indicating stronger temperature sensitivity with CaCO 3 addition. These findings demonstrate that CaCO 3 modifies sulfur distribution and the apparent kinetic behavior of PbS-containing systems.

The Swedish childhood cancer quality registry for risk-based long-term follow-up after childhood cancer: structure, content, and development over time
abstractText: Abstract Background Survival after childhood cancer has increased dramatically during the last 50–60 years. Today, approximately 86% of childhood cancer patients in Sweden survive more than 5 years, and most of them reach adulthood. The intense multimodal cancer treatment is unfortunately associated with a risk of late complications during childhood or later in adult life. A registry for monitoring late complications is an important tool to support structured long-term follow-up. In Sweden this is available through the SALUB database, a part of the Swedish childhood cancer quality registry. The aim of this study is to describe the SALUB database and assess its coverage, its capacity to identify treatment-defined risk groups for late complications, and the completeness of long-term follow-up data. Methods A cohort of patients who had reached at least 19 years of age, were born before 01/07/2006, and had received or were assumed to have received systemic cancer treatment or radiotherapy was identified in the Swedish childhood cancer quality registry. Database coverage was assessed by individual-level linkage, using personal identity numbers, between the SALUB database and the diagnosis-based databases. Subpopulations were assessed to explore changes over time, identify treatment-defined risk group, and assess the completeness of follow-up data. Results The coverage was 73% (3,780/5,171) in the overall cohort and 94% (803/853) in patients born between 2002 and 2006. The number of individuals at risk for cardiotoxicity and gonadal toxicity were easily identified. A total of 1,809 patients had at least one follow-up record meeting the inclusion criteria. Data completeness varied markedly across organ systems. Conclusions The SALUB database has high coverage among younger survivors and enables identification of individuals according to treatment-defined risks of late complications. However, lower coverage in older survivors and incomplete follow-up data currently limit some of its potential applications. Continued development of the database will strengthen its role in risk-based survivorship care, health care planning, and research.

title: Transformasi Digital dalam Pendidikan di Indonesia
abstractText: Pertumbuhan penelitian transformasi digital pendidikan di Indonesia memerlukan pemetaan untuk memahami struktur pengetahuan, perubahan tema, dan kesenjangan bukti. Penelitian ini bertujuan menganalisis perkembangan publikasi, sitasi, kolaborasi, struktur konseptual, evolusi tematik, serta agenda penelitian. Analisis bibliometrik dipadukan dengan telaah substantif melalui seleksi literatur berpedoman PRISMA. Kumpulan awal mencakup 899 artikel dari Dimensions, dengan 401 artikel periode 2024–2026 ditetapkan sebagai korpus akhir berdasarkan kriteria kelayakan dan ketersediaan teks lengkap. Data dicatat menggunakan formulir ekstraksi terstruktur dan dianalisis melalui statistik publikasi, jejaring kolaborasi, kemunculan bersama istilah, pemetaan tematik, serta sintesis isi dengan dukungan VOSviewer dan Biblioshiny. Hasil menunjukkan pertumbuhan publikasi tahunan sebesar 112,67%, sedangkan kolaborasi internasional hanya mencapai 2,244% dan jejaring antarpenulis masih terfragmentasi. Tiga klaster utama mencakup infrastruktur dan pedagogi digital, kepemimpinan dan tata kelola, serta pendidikan tinggi dengan pendekatan kuantitatif. Penekanan tematik bergeser dari kesiapan digital menuju pembelajaran, analisis, dan perancangan. Telaah substantif mengidentifikasi kebutuhan penelitian mengenai kepemimpinan digital, keselarasan pendidikan vokasi dengan industri, dan keberlanjutan. Penelitian ini menyimpulkan bahwa perkembangan literatur perlu diikuti penguatan kolaborasi dan pengujian empiris hubungan antara kesiapan institusi, penerapan teknologi, dan hasil pendidikan. Interpretasi temuan dibatasi oleh cakupan satu basis data dan periode pengamatan yang singkat.

title: Advancing Pediatric Workforce Diversity and Culturally Effective Health Care for a Changing US Child Population: Policy Recommendations for Change: Policy Statement
abstractText: This policy statement provides recommendations on enhancing pediatrician workforce diversity and providing culturally effective health care (CEHC). It highlights the barriers that racism and other biases create in providing culturally effective pediatric care and achieving child health equity. There are 3 interconnected areas needing greater attention: 1) expanding the underrepresented in medicine (URiM) candidate pool through fostering health career aspirations among diverse youth; 2) enhancing recruitment, retention, and leadership development of URiM pediatricians through facilitating health care system change; and 3) advancing CEHC delivery through synergistic efforts addressing care during clinical encounters, ability to access care, and ongoing improvement processes.

title: Family Values in the Hierarchy of Youth Life Priorities: Based on Regional Survey Data
abstractText: The article examines the value orientations of Russian youth (aged 19-35, N = 414) in the context of the traditional family values and self-realization, drawing on a 2025 sociological survey conducted in the Tyumen region, carried out within the framework of the state assigned research topic «Unification and Diversity in the Spatial Development of Russia (Socio-Economic and Socio-Cultural Processes)». The analysis of 17 life goals reveals that family-oriented values (child-rearing: 93.0 %, harmonious family relations: 96.4 %, material provision for the family: 96.4%) consistently occupy top positions across all age cohorts (19-25, 26-30, 31-35). At the same time, a pronounced age-related drift is observed: career importance declines from 87.5 % (age 19-25) to 57.6 % (age 31-35), while the value of «having a family business» rises from 30.0 % to 40.0 %. Significant gender differences are identified, most notably in «being a family leader» (males: 60.8 %, females: 28.1 %). Social optimism declines with age (from 77.3 % to 70.9 %), accompanied by growing skepticism toward state support for childbearing. The author concludes that the value profile of contemporary Russian youth represents not a conflict but a sequential integration of individualistic and family-oriented priorities, where the self-realization stage precedes family consolidation within the life course

title: Beyond decibels alone: environmental noise, auditory diversity, and person–environment interactions in autism
abstractText: Environmental noise is a ubiquitous physical exposure and a biologically active non-auditory stressor, yet its relevance to autism has received substantially less attention compared to chemical components of the urban exposome. Two questions are often conflated: whether prenatal or early-life noise contributes to autism-related neurodevelopmental susceptibility and whether adverse auditory environments increase functional burden after autistic characteristics are present. In this structured narrative review, we integrate environmental epidemiology, developmental and auditory neuroscience, sleep and stress research, and environmental acoustics within a two-pathway life-course framework. PubMed/MEDLINE and the Web of Science Core Collection were searched from inception through 4 September 2026, supplemented by targeted Google Scholar searching. We included English-language peer-reviewed primary studies, systematic reviews and meta-analyses, and authoritative guidance or standards documents and excluded conference abstracts, dissertations, and preprints. Evidence was prioritized by directness to the autism question, study design, exposure characterization, outcome validity, precision, and recency; the evidence matrix is intentionally selective. Direct human evidence that quantified environmental noise independently increasing the risk of autism diagnosis or persistently worsening autistic traits is sparse and inconsistent, and current data do not support a causal claim. A more direct functional evidence stream—studies conducted on autistic participants that experimentally manipulate auditory conditions and/or measure real-world functional outcomes—indicates that some autistic individuals show altered auditory responsivity, reduced or delayed habituation, speech-in-noise and selective-attention difficulties, and greater burden in noisy or unpredictable settings. We conceptualize this pathway as a person–environment interaction in which acoustic structure, sensory phenotype, task demand, and predictability or control jointly shape functioning. Standard metrics such as LAeq, Lden, and Lnight remain necessary for comparability and policy and are supplemented, not replaced, by multidimensional characterization. Event peaks and temporal fluctuation receive empirical support from studies on child neurodevelopment, whereas spectral content, reverberation, source multiplicity, predictability, controllability, and personal time–activity patterns remain framework-generated hypotheses requiring direct autism-specific testing. This framework separates etiologic inference from phenotypic modification and identifies testable priorities for early-life research and co-designed acoustic accessibility.

Kết quả cho thấy ứng phó tập trung vào cảm xúc được sử dụng nhiều nhất, tiếp đến là ứng phó né tránh và ứng phó tập trung vào vấn đề; trong đó Giải tỏa cảm xúc và Chấp nhận có mức sử dụng cao nhất. Một số chiến lược có sự khác biệt theo trường học, giới tính và nơi cư trú.
